verdicts.decision_note: The client accepts the concrete proposal to add battery-protection hardware; the NTC aspect belongs to the separate temperature-monitoring Requirement.
The client specifies the AXP2101 overcharge and overdischarge cutoff behavior, which directly affects the battery-protection circuit.
The client materially questions whether the requested additional battery protection concerns hard-short protection or another protection mode.
The client accepts the immediately preceding clarification that the additional circuit behavior is thermal protection rather than hard-short protection.
The accepted thermal-protection interpretation resolves the material value ambiguity and returns the battery-protection Requirement to active implementation.
This exchange concerns connector placement on the integrated board and does not modify battery-protection scope or behavior.
